ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized at edges and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey base across the fluke surface. High-contrast white geometric blobs (barnacles) are clustered at the distal tips of both lobes. Discrete white focal spots are scattered across the mid-region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels along the continuous lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the superior margins of both lobes, transitioning into a concave curve as it approaches the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups located on the distal upper margins. Isolated circular white clusters are also present on the interior surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast linear white pixel disruptions (scars) crossing both lobes, with high density on the lower-left and lower-right regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the fluke surface and significant barnacle encrustation on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Subtle grey-on-black tonal mottling visible in the central and lower-right regions of the fluke surface.
